blocks.text: Pitt Meadows houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Pitt Meadows peaked at 53 in September 2025 and bottomed at 21 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in May 2026 with 13. The reported sale price moved from $1,187,500 to $1,160,000, a change of −2.3%.

faq.q: How much of Pitt Meadows is farmland or floodplain?
faq.a: The City's 2020 Business Plan states 78% of the land base is in the Agricultural Land Reserve and over 95% lies within the Fraser and Pitt river floodplains behind the dike system, so both checks are part of a purchase on most lots.

faq.q: Which schools are in Pitt Meadows, and is there a middle school?
faq.a: SD42 lists four elementary schools — Davie Jones, Edith McDermott, Highland Park and Pitt Meadows Elementary, all Kindergarten to Grade 7 — and one secondary school, Pitt Meadows Secondary, Grade 8 to Grade 12, so there is no middle tier; check a specific address in the SD42 School Locator.

faq.q: How does transit connect Pitt Meadows to other cities?
faq.a: The R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place with a Harris Road stop, the 701 runs Coquitlam Central to Haney Place, the 791 runs Braid Station to Haney Place, the 595 runs to Langley Centre over the Golden Ears Bridge, and the West Coast Express stops at Pitt Meadows Station.

faq.q: Are secondary suites and garden suites allowed?
faq.a: Yes, in the zones that list them — the zoning bylaw lists secondary suites and garden suites as accessory uses in the RS, RR, R-4 and R-6 zones, and the City garden suite guide sets one suite per lot at 33 sq m to 90 sq m.

faq.q: What are the main commute routes out of Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: Lougheed Highway crosses the Pitt River Bridge west to Port Coquitlam and Coquitlam, Golden Ears Way crosses the Golden Ears Bridge south to Langley and Surrey, and the West Coast Express runs from Pitt Meadows Station to Waterfront Station in Vancouver on weekdays.
